title: Phase-aware multi-GPU handoff coordinator for hybrid token streaming and elastic NCCL overlap
creator: Maya Singh
description: Goal: build a phase-aware coordinator that reduces end-to-end tail latency and variance for large-model prefill+decode workloads across heterogeneous multi-GPU clusters. The coordinator will: 1) orchestrate token handoffs across tensor- and pipeline-parallel stages using explicit phase signals rather than coarse barriers; 2) expose elastic NCCL rendezvous windows that adapt to microbatch shapes and device bandwidth; 3) surface kernel selection hints to the local executor during handoff (attention mode, fused-kernel candidate, quantization path); and 4) provide graceful fallbacks when overlap targets are missed (staggered decode, local partial-reduce). This ticket covers design, simulator experiments, PoC integration with the conductor, and an end-to-end benchmark harness.
acceptance_criteria: Phase signals (PREFILL_START, PREFILL_DONE, DECODE_PHASE, HANDOFF_READY) implemented in the conductor and propagated to stage proxies
Elastic NCCL rendezvous windows reduce measured inter-stage stall time by >=15% on 8xA100 heterogeneous tests compared to baseline static windows
Kernel-hint API implemented and exercised by at least two attention-mode choices (full attention vs. chunked fused attention) during prefill and decode
End-to-end 99th percentile latency for 2k-token prefill + 512-token decode workloads improves by >=12% on representative topology (2-way tensor x 4-way pipeline) across the CI harness
Telemetry events for missed overlap, fallback activation, and per-handshake bandwidth recorded and visible in Console rollout dashboard

2025-02-18 - Kazuo Tanaka (review): Suggested adding 'soft-priority lanes' to prioritize critical tokens (prefixes) when bandwidth is constrained. Also recommended measuring KV cache hit interplay with staggered handoffs.

2025-03-01 - Luca Moreno: Integrated kernel-hint API into local executor. Two prototype kernels wired: fused-attention-chunk and chunked-attention-stream. Microbenchmarks show fused path beats chunked at seq_len <= 1536 but loses at long seqs.

2025-03-03 - Performance lab: Ran heterogeneous 8xA100 test with elastic windows enabled. Inter-stage stalls dropped ~18% and 99p latency improved ~13% versus baseline. Preparing PR and dashboard snapshots.
